methods.method_description: This method verifies that all the expected UI elements on the settings screen are visible and correctly displayed to ensure proper rendering and accessibility.

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: A boolean flag to indicate if the user is currently logged in, which may affect the visibility of certain settings elements based on authentication state.

methods.method_purpose: The primary purpose of this method is to perform a comprehensive visual validation of the settings screen elements to ensure UI integrity and verify that all expected components are properly displayed and accessible to the user.
